visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The main female character appears in a bright studio environment, wearing a black and white striped sweater and holding a round cushion compact and two small lip products. She smiles at the camera, her hair held back by a silver clip. (2) The scene cuts to a retail shelf in a Japanese FamilyMart, displaying the 'hana by hince' makeup line with various pink and beige packaging. (3) The perspective returns to the character who holds up a small, rectangular pink lip tint close to her face to highlight the product detail. (4) A exterior shot shows a Japanese FamilyMart store front under clear daylight. (5) Back to the retail shelf, panning across lipsticks and blushes arranged in cardboard displays. (6) A mobile interface screen capture appears, scrolling through the official website of 'hana by hince' showing various cosmetic items. (7) A flat lay on a white surface shows a collection of the products including a cushion, blushes, and liquid primers. (8) The character demonstrates the primer by applying a white cream to her cheek; the screen is split into 'Before' and 'After' to show the tone-up effect. (9) She then applies the round cushion foundation to her face using a puff, showing the smooth, natural finish. (12) Using her finger, she dabs a cream blush from a circular container onto her cheek, blending it for a soft glow. (13) She demonstrates a highlighter by swiping a finger over the product and then over the back of her hand and cheekbone. (15) Finally, she holds four boxed products together and points towards the bottom of the frame, concluding with a double thumbs-up and a smile.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Product-by-Product Review -> Summary -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty product review and recommendation for the Japanese convenience store makeup brand 'hana by hince'. It aims to inform viewers of a high-value, affordable alternative to popular makeup items, demonstrated through hands-on testing and before-and-after comparisons. It concludes with an audience engagement giveaway.
